mapper.select: SELECT id, tool_call_id, tool_invocation_id, run_id, tool_name, mcp_server_name, mcp_transport_type, status, input_schema_ref, intent_ref, arguments_ref, receipt_ref, failure_code, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_tool_call WHERE tool_call_id = #{toolCallId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_tool_call SET arguments_ref = #{argumentsRef}, receipt_ref = #{receiptRef}, status = #{status}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE tool_call_id = #{toolCallId}
